posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Prologue:  Six months, six months. . . Legacy thought as he paced the ship.  Baron Blade had been on Mars for six months.  By all calculations they would arrive too late.  "Sir, we'll make it, they'll stall him long enough," the lieutenant tried to reassure him.  "I know Soldier, just anxious to get to work," Legacy knew the soldier didn't believe that any more than he did.

How Baron Blade could disappear for six months, a full six months before they found him.  Even then it wasn't the F5 team, or even the CIA who found him.  If that sub-contractor had delayed in filing his tax statements they wouldn't have pieced it together until the Baron made his demands.  As is they got a 5 week head start.  All those false leads and missed clues, and with so much on the line.  Hopefully there would still be an Earth to save.

 

Number of Heroes:  3-5

Required Heroes:  Legacy

Banned Heroes:  Omnitron-X, The Visionary, The Scholar, Chrono-Ranger and all promo cards.

Villain:  Baron Blade, special Scenario version.

Environment:  Wagner Mars Base

Special set-up:  Baron Blade starts with 2 mobile defense platforms in play.

Special Gameplay:  End of villain turn discard the top (H)-1 cards of the villain deck.

Game does not end if Terra-Lunar Impulse Beam succeeds, instead Baron Blade flips.

At flip the changes for the second side will be revealed. (It's still a fight to the death)

 

So if you want in call out your hero, we want a good number of F5 heroes, but 1 or 2 friends works well too.

The team in order:

Legacy:  grysqrl

Fanatic:  PlatinumWarlock

Wraith:  dpt

Absolute Zero:  cmschex

Tachyon:  BlueHairedMeerkat

 

This fight is a nasty one, and intentionally so.  The story doesn't end if you lose, you know shattered time and all that, there are six possible endings to this fight, and each has a pretty good chance of occuring.  Each takes you on a very diffrerent path.

 

Disclaimer:  I am not a good writer, decent story teller, but not a good writer.  So bear with me.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
They were slowing, the reverse thrust was a very strange sensation and the weak gravity didn't feel weak after so long being weightless.  Legacy looked around, the team was ready.  Lt. Vance had been missed, no one was better at balancing the personalities of the freedom 5.  As lucky as they were to have Helena with them, her and Frost didn't get along so well, and both had ended up spening most of the trip in isolation.  Dr. Stinson had offered to "get out and push" more than once, and reminded the pilots at least once a day how long it would have taken her to run to Mars.  Wraith had handled it the best, she had money invested in some of the research that had been going on before the Baron arrived, and her thoughts were more on the people she had sent there than those she left behind, she spent most of her days training for low gravity combat and reviewing blueprints for the various remodellings of the base.  Legacy couldn't blame any of them, he was homesick himself, but more than that, he was worried that they were too late.

They had been able to monitor transmissions for the first half of the trip, but it was now 3 weeks since they had gone silent, even listening could tip off the Baron that they were closing in.  Legacy silently cast a prayer to whomever might listen, and prepared himself for what lay in wait for them at the Mars Base.

. . . 

So much for the element of surprise.  The recorded greeting was bad enough, but having still warm tea waiting for them at the airlock was just insulting.  Fortunately Wraith's time studying the blueprints had yielded some good results.  There were two service tunnels that had been abandoned and didn't show up on any blueprints from the last two years.  The Baron hadn't checked that carefully, and with a bit of sneaking around they were closing in on the orbital control center, the only place where he could rebuild his Terraunar Impulsion device, at least according to Dr. Stinson.  The Baron had started the countdown as soon as they had entered.  "I don't know what will be more satisfying, seeing your face when you fail to save the Earth, or killing you afterwards!" the base echoed with the taunts Baron Blade hurled at them, at him.  He knew the Baron was trying to make him angry, he knew he needed to stay cool headed and focused to win, but he also knew that all this was aimed at him.  Baron Blade wasn't going to destroy the moon and most of the planet to take over the remnants, he was doing it for revenge.  At least the Earth was still OK, and Baron Blade's wish to see Legacy face to face would soon be granted.

 

ROUND ONE

Baron Blade

HP:  40

In Play:  Mobile Defense Platform [10], Mobile Defense Platform [10]

Trash:

------------------------------

Start of Turn:  Less that 15 cards in the villain trash.

Play a Card:  Devious Disruption no Equipment to destroy, each hero takes 3 lightning damage.

End of Turn:  The top 4 cards of the villain deck are discarded to the trash.

------------------------------

HP:  40

In Play:  Mobile Defense Platform [10], Mobile Defense Platform [10]

Trash:(5)  Devious disruption, Powered Remote Turret, Blade Battalion, Flesh-Repair Nanites, Backlash Field.

Effects:

ST:  If there are 15 or more cards in the villain trash the TerraLunar Impulsion Beam activates.

ET:  discard the top 4 cards of the villain deck.

Static:  Baron Blade is immune to damage (Mobile Defense Platform)

Hero Status:

Legacy:  28

Fanatic:  27

Wraith:  23

Absolute Zero:  26

Tachyon:  24

Baron Blade flips when he hits 0hp, and the check for 15 cards in the villain trash is the first thing that happens during the villain turn, so it would not be possible for those events to conflict.  Advanced Blade gives a discard of (H)-2 at End of turn, I upped that to (H)-1 and added the second defense platform.  You have three rounds until he wins, provided he doesn't get all three hasten dooms early.
